CommunityApplications.Profile: Verbatim generates English closed captions from the English dub audio track of media you already own. Almost every "English" subtitle file is a translation of the Japanese audio, so it does not match what the dub actually says; this transcribes the dub itself using faster-whisper on your GPU. Runs entirely on your server, with batch queueing, a Sonarr webhook, a playback preview and a caption editor.
